definitions.explanation: The residents or citizens of a town (町). Used in official and administrative contexts to refer to the people living in a municipality classified as a 町.

examples.japanese: {町民|ちょうみん}{全員|ぜんいん}に{通知|つうち}が{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: A notice was delivered to all town residents.

examples.japanese: {町民|ちょうみん}{体育館|たいいくかん}でイベントが{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: An event will be held at the town gymnasium.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{条例|じょうれい}について{町民|ちょうみん}からの{意見|いけん}を{募集|ぼしゅう}している。
examples.english: They are soliciting opinions from town residents regarding the new ordinance.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in administrative and official contexts. Japan's municipalities are classified as {市|し} (city), {町|ちょう}/{町|まち} (town), or {村|むら}/{村|そん} (village), and each has its own term for residents: {市民|しみん}, {町民|ちょうみん}, {村民|そんみん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {町民|ちょうみん}{税|ぜい} (town resident tax)
- {町民|ちょうみん}{体育館|たいいくかん} (town gymnasium)
- {町民|ちょうみん}{会館|かいかん} (town community hall)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {市民|しみん}: city residents — for cities ({市|し})
- {村民|そんみん}: village residents — for villages ({村|むら})
- {住民|じゅうみん}: residents — a general term for residents of any area
